race.comment: CAPTAIN REDBEARD (5) is in great form lately, lifting strongly to score over 1400m at Warrnambool last time, making it two wins on the trot. Looks ready for the longer journey and might just be a little sharper than some of the other talented types in this, who are at their best over further. DURBAN HARBOUR (6) is one of them, but has been freshened since disappointing 51 days ago when 10th over 2400m at Sandown. This is the right grade for him to run a race at this trip, though. SOLDIER BOI (9) is back from a spell and does go well when fresh, including a win to launch last campaign over 1525m at Geelong. Fitter for a recent trial win at Burrumbeet. Key runner. THE MUFFIN MAN (11) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1300m at Bendigo, beaten 3 lengths. Fitter so anticipating a better run this time. HAARACAINE (2) was plain first-up, but had market respect there and has performed well in better grade than this so might be worth another chance.
